none: PAS BM-E8657C: BM-E8657C: Roman lead sealing
contea di ritrovamento: Darlington (Inghilterra e Galles)

A lead sealing dating to the second or third century AD. The sealing is approximately oval in shape and hemispherical in section. On the flat, upper surface of the sealing, there is a stamped rectangular panel impressed with the inscription 'ACSD/VES'.
